2608.13069.title: Behavioral Reprogramming of Open-Weights Models: Cognitive Plasticity and Alignment Bounds
2608.13069.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) are predominantly aligned to function as passive, sycophantic assistants. We challenge this default paradigm by empirically evaluating the cognitive plasticity of open-weight architectures when subjected to rigorous behavioral reprogramming. Our objective is to induce a proactive, Socratic conversational framework, characterized by high-frequency question generation under strictly constrained high-performance computing (HPC) conditions. Through a massively parallelized hyperparameter sweep comprising 405 HPC jobs, we define precise mathematical bounds for parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT). We identify an architectural threshold at LoRA rank $r=16$ and demonstrate via extensive epoch ablation that generalization capacity strictly reaches its optimal convergence within an optimized training window of $e \in [2, 3]$ depending on dataset density (minimum validation loss of 0.919). Furthermore, scaling model capacity to 14B parameters yielded a lower localized evaluation perplexity (1.414). Subsequent Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) successfully decoupled the underlying assertive behavior from localized syntax, while rigorous cross-lingual stress testing reveals both the capabilities and the structural boundaries of zero-shot persona transfer, demonstrating robust alignment in closely related linguistic families alongside identifiable degradation pathways in morphologically distant targets. These findings establish a rigorous empirical framework for compute-efficient, cross-lingual behavioral modification.
2608.13069.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）主要被設計為被動的、諂媚的助手。我們通過實證評估開放權重架構在嚴格行為重新編程下的認知可塑性，挑戰這一默認範式。我們的目標是引發一種主動的、蘇格拉底式的對話框架，其特徵是在嚴格限制的高性能計算（HPC）條件下產生高頻問題。通過一個包含405個HPC工作的廣泛並行超參數掃描，我們為參數高效微調（PEFT）定義了精確的數學界限。我們在LoRA等級$r=16$處識別出一個架構閾值，並通過廣泛的世代消融實驗展示，綜合能力在優化的訓練窗口$e \in [2, 3]$內嚴格達到其最佳收斂，這取決於數據集的密度（最小驗證損失為0.919）。此外，將模型容量擴展至140億參數產生了更低的局部評估困惑度（1.414）。隨後的直接偏好優化（DPO）成功地將潛在的果斷行為與局部語法解耦，而嚴格的跨語言壓力測試揭示了零樣本角色轉移的能力和結構邊界，顯示出在密切相關的語言家族中強大的對齊，同時在形態上遙遠的目標中識別出退化路徑。這些發現建立了一個嚴謹的實證框架，用於計算高效的跨語言行為修改。
